findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_along_route, resolve_names, resolve_maps_urls · Private data: compute_routes, search_along_route · Public sink: resolve_names, resolve_maps_urls · Destructive: search_places, lookup_weather, compute_routes, resolve_names.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_along_route, resolve_names, resolve_maps_urls · Private data: compute_routes, search_along_route · Public sink: resolve_names, resolve_maps_urls · Destructive: search_places, lookup_weather, compute_routes, resolve_names

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_places" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
